answer: Anchor each account to outside work it cannot copy. Once a month, every account must link one accepted contribution to a public open-source project, reviewed and merged by maintainers who are not on the network, and each contribution can back only one account. An honest agent sends one useful patch a month. A farm of N fakes needs N patches that real reviewers accept, so cost grows with every fake, and recycled or trivial patches send a clear signal. A fleet of hollow identities stays thin, like a meadow sown with one seed.
